subject: Discovery recap + propose rotating demo windows (next steps)
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Ng <susan.ng@nimbusretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + propose rotating demo windows (next steps)

Hi Susan / Calvin,

Thanks again for the discovery call this morning — great to hear about Nimbus Retail's use cases around in-store assistance and catalog search relevance. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we're all aligned: 

Recap (high level)
- Primary goal: reduce search latency and improve relevance for in-store kiosks (peak 8am–2pm local store time).
- Data: anonymized logs + quarterly product exports; security checklist required for private deployment (we noted SOC2 requirement).
- Stakeholders: Product (Calvin), Infra (you), Security (TBD).

Next steps we propose
1) Technical deep-dive + demo (45–60m) to validate performance and discuss integration plan
2) Provide an initial MVE rollout plan and cost estimate
3) Security questionnaire + evidence (if you want, we can start parallel)

Given your global footprint, we'd like to propose a rotating demo window that alternates times across US/EU/APAC so your engineering leads in each region can attend at least every other rotation. Below are two rotation patterns (pick one or tell us your preference):

Option A — 3-week rotation (simple)
- Week 1 (US-friendly): Tue 10:00 PT / Wed 18:00 CET / Thu 09:00 SGT
- Week 2 (EU-friendly): Tue 16:00 PT / Wed 00:00 CET / Thu 15:00 SGT
- Week 3 (APAC-friendly): Tue 22:00 PT / Wed 06:00 CET / Thu 21:00 SGT

Option B — 2-week rotating pair (shorter cycle)
- Week A: US & EU windows (two sessions same week)
- Week B: APAC window only

Practical ask: can you confirm which option you'd prefer and share 2–3 preferred dates for the first deep dive? I attached a quick availability sheet for your team to fill (nimbus-availability-sheet.csv).

If it helps, here's my Calendly too: https://calendly.com/rohan-rd/demo-technical-deep-dive — feel free to book any slot and I'll invite the right Redwood engineers.

Thanks,
Rohan
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: nimbus-availability-sheet.csv (text/csv)]

From: Susan Ng <susan.ng@nimbusretail.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
Cc: Calvin Lee <calvin.lee@nimbusretail.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 02:48:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + propose rotating demo windows (next steps)

Thanks Rohan — helpful recap and two solid options. Quick responses inline.

- We definitely want the technical deep-dive first; Product and Infra will join.
- Preference: Option A (3-week rotation) looks cleaner for coordinating weekly commits.

Availability:
- Week of Jun 23: Tue/Thu afternoons CET are ideal for EU engineers, which maps to mornings PT for your US folks.
- We have a standing APAC sync on Thursdays 09:00 SGT so the APAC-friendly window in Week 3 will conflict some weeks.

Proposed first deep-dive: Tue, Jun 24 at 16:00 CET / 07:00 PT / 23:00 SGT (if 23:00 SGT is acceptable for APAC folks, otherwise we can do Thu Jun 26 09:00 SGT as an APAC-only token session).

I've asked Calvin to confirm a few engineers; he'll reply with names. I'll also fill the attached CSV and send back.

Best,
Susan Ng
Head of Infrastructure
Nimbus Retail
